name: Devjatyj Nositel'
source:
A ship by the name of 'Lilith' has been navigating through space for two years with a single goal – reaching Eden, the heart of the Universe. The ship's team, consisting of Captain Lazarus, First Mate Anna, and Second Mate Joseph, is constantly fighting through hundreds and hundreds of enemy 'Phantom 4s' that have been chasing them throughout the whole trip.
But the final frontier stands before them: Eden is almost within hand's reach...

[From [url=https://nikita-kryukov.itch.io/daiku-no-medium]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一艘名为“莉莉丝”的飞船已经在太空中航行了两年，只有一个目标——到达宇宙的中心伊甸园。这艘船由船长拉扎勒斯、大副安娜和二副约瑟夫组成，他们在整个旅程中不断与成百上千的敌人“幻影4”进行战斗。
但最后的边界就在他们面前：伊甸园几乎触手可及……

[来自[url=https://nikita-kryukov.itch.io/daiku-no-medium]itch.io[/url]]
